title: 305 Fishkill Avenue
synopsis: A kind-hearted janitor witnesses dangerous criminal activity at his neighboring apartment building: 305 Fishkill Avenue. The problem is no one believes this address even exists.

title: A King Displaced
synopsis: Daniel Hungbeji navigates his daily life both as a fisherman and as a traditional ruler within the water settlement of Makoko, Lagos, Nigeria.

title: Altanegra
director: Raiza De La Hoz, Daniela Ponce
synopsis: In a territory marked by promises of equality and realities of exclusion, being young, Black, and from a rural community becomes an act of everyday resistance.

title: Amazonas Cocinas Indigenas de Selva y Rio
synopsis: This documentary explores the ancestral knowledge preserved through the kitchens of the forest and the river. Through traditional recipes, gathering practices, and the deep relationship between people and nature.

title: Amelia
synopsis: Defiance, strength, bravery, love, and loss—these are the heart of Amelia's story. More than just a tale about our protagonist, it is uniquely told through her perspective. As a married Nigerian woman living in relative poverty in the year 2002.

title: BERTHA
synopsis: ULDA (65) refuses to take charge of her macho husband's funeral because he died in another woman's bed. At home, only Bertha, a mischievous goat, remains as her companion while she returns to the woman she once was.

title: CAPTAIN ANTHONY
synopsis: In 1942, Anthony is a ten-year-old boy living on the island of Providencia, Colombia. He dreams of becoming a great schooner captain like his father, and goes to school every day to learn about the sea and navigation from his teacher Fabio.

title: Cafe ?
synopsis: Ouzin, Baba and Sémou, longtime friends and retirees, never miss their daily coffee meetup. But every year, in April, Sémou is haunted by the loss of his first love. One afternoon, as Ouzin and Baba grow concerned about their friend, Sémou doesn't show up for coffee.

title: Carabali
synopsis: An Afro-Colombian community leader is threatened and forced into exile. Far from his land and family, Carabalí resists in displacement, clinging to the hope of returning one day to the place where he belongs.

title: FACE TO FACE
synopsis: At a difficult moment in his personal and professional life, choreographer Florent Mahoukou returns to the city of Pointe Noire, where, for him, everything began with dance.

title: God's Work
synopsis: In a derelict building on the outskirts of Durban, a group of homeless men carve out a fragile existence amid violence, addiction, and the constant threat of being erased.

title: INITIATION INTO THE EIGHTH DIMENSION
synopsis: Five Afro-Colombian characters in the middle of Bogotá, five disparate destinies in a city that is hostile to them. Rubi Quejada, a young model displaced from Chocó.

title: Leer en las gotas de lluvia
synopsis: An Angolan artist and mother, her four-year-old daughter, and a New Zealand painter create imaginary worlds in new lands. These find echo in the poem by Xisca Minart, Read in Raindrops.

title: Manman Chadwon
synopsis: An anthem to fantastic femininity, to life, to freedom, and to metamorphosis, at once intimate and revolutionary. It is a sensory chant, a dreamlike reflection on the feminine condition within a destructive masculine world.

title: Mojugba
synopsis: Fanny, an Afro-Colombian leader, turns the Mojugba, a Yoruba ritual of ancestral invocation, into an act of resistance. In a country that tries to erase its history, she teaches that remembering is revolutionary.

title: One Sunday
synopsis: One Sunday tells the story of a possible encounter between Samuel and a stray bullet. The bullet comes from a gunshot fired in the favela where Samuel lives. On a sunny Sunday, Samuel decides to take advantage of his day off to go to the beach.

title: POSESAS [Possessed]
synopsis: Based on a critical and counter-current review of the historical figure of Javiera Londoño, an 18th-century landowner who supposedly contributed to the abolition of slavery in the region of Antioquia, Colombia.

title: Sapeur: The Great Scam
synopsis: In the slums of Palanca, in Luanda, the charismatic mechanic and sapeur Jacob promises his son Alberto a house he cannot afford. Desperate, he teams up with his shady friend Lunda in a scam: posing as a wealthy landowner to sell non-existent plots of land to French investors.

title: Sisters in Destiny: Angela Davis & Gerty Archimede
synopsis: Two women. Two continents. One shared fight. From Guadeloupe to the United States, Sisters in Destiny explores the intertwined journeys of Gerty Archimède, a trailblazer of feminism.

title: Stories from La Guajirita
director: David Antonio Diaz de la rosa
synopsis: Relatos de la Guajirita tells the story of the Afro-descendant communities of Becerril, Cesar, through their memories, traditions, music, and oral narratives.

title: Stormy Days
synopsis: Ahura is a wheelchair carrier who tries to escape at all costs, but finds Gymbia being attacked. He saves her and begins his journey in search of love and freedom.

title: Viva Yurumangui
synopsis: On the remote Pacific coast of Colombia, the inhabitants of the Yurumanguí palenque still fight for freedom, hundreds of years after their ancestors fled slavery.

title: When the world broke open
synopsis: At the height of the 1904 Herero and Nama genocide in German South West Africa, a young, pregnant Herero woman named Jorokee flees the smoldering ruins of her village with her husband Unomuinjo...

title: Wrong Generation
synopsis: Following a series of brutal murders—the last of which takes the life of his childhood friend—a group of estranged best friends reconnects to organize the largest protest in post-apartheid Namibia.
